title: TestAtlas Command Result
description: Schema for history/command_history.jsonl entries and 10_command_log.md table rows (PRD §30). 9 required fields (command, invokedAt, completedAt, status, outputs, errors, artifactsCreated, artifactsUpdated, manifestUpdated) plus 1 optional `executionMode` enum populated by orchestrator commands (Quick 260505-hld / F-11 Option A). Existing rows without `executionMode` continue to validate.

executionMode.description: How this command's child tasks were executed. Set by orchestrator commands (e.g. /atlas:explore in Option A spawn-and-aggregate mode); omitted for non-orchestrator commands. 'classify-only' is preserved for back-compat with Quick 260505-ge3 dogfood records.
